meta.name: Domina
meta.description:
The extraordinary rise of Livia Drusilla, who overcame adversity to become the most powerful woman in the world. Follow Livia’s journey from a naïve young girl whose world crumbles in the wake of Julius Caesar’s assassination, to Rome’s most powerful and influential Empress.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Fall
videos.overview: Livia Drusilla loses everything in the Civil War as her father and husband find themselves defeated and forced into exile.

videos.title: Rise
videos.overview: When an amnesty is declared, a pregnant Livia returns to Rome to rebuild her family fortunes and save her friend.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Eleven years on, Livia is married to the powerful Gaius, and is pregnant again. Yet, she does not feel entirely secure.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Livia's marriage to Gaius is compromised when she learns that she can't bear him any children.

videos.title: Plague
videos.overview: Gaius' illness causes a political crisis and reveals the weakness of Livia's position without him, a problem she must solve.

videos.title: Nightshade
videos.overview: Livia has no choice but to eliminate Marcellus, who plans to kill her sons and exile her when he assumes Gaius' position.

videos.title: Treason
videos.overview: As Gaius' rivals taste blood in the water, Livia must outwit both them and her husband if the family is to be kept together.

videos.title: Happiness
videos.overview: As Livia tells her sons about their role in her Mission, the truth behind her part in Marcellus' death threatens to come out.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Livia and Gaius return to famine in Rome. Gaius starts a succession race.

videos.title: Wedding
videos.overview: Drusus and Antonina’s wedding is threatened. Livia’s marriage is tested.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Livia and Gemina come face to face with life-changing consequences. Drusus’ military career is in danger.

videos.title: Exile
videos.overview: Livia’s missed in Rome, and must deal with a threat to her sons and secure Gaius’ forgiveness.

videos.title: Sacrilege
videos.overview: Gaius’ plans for the succession shock Livia. Tiberius grows suspicious of Gaius.

videos.title: Freedom
videos.overview: Shocking news brings instability to Rome. Livia must make a dangerous choice.

videos.title: Curse
videos.overview: Livia is threatened on her way to a wedding and has to make a life-threatening decision.

videos.title: Control
videos.overview: Livia must reassert control of the family. News from Germany has devastating consequences.

meta.slogan: It's not about power. It's about everything.
